marketing / Outbound

Smartlead

Make outbound follow-up measurable and manageable.

SOfficial product ↗Open in the hierarchy →
Level 4Inspect the detail

Smartlead supports outbound email campaigns, connected sending accounts, sequences, and reply handling. MoreSpace can structure a controlled outreach engine that keeps personalization relevant, routes interested responses to sales, and connects campaign activity with meeting and pipeline outcomes.

Useful outputs

  • Scheduled outreach sequences with campaign-level tracking
  • Categorized replies and assigned sales follow-up tasks
  • Delivery, bounce, response, and meeting outcome reports

Where we can apply it

  • Clay-enriched prospect → reviewed sequence → interested reply → CRM owner.
  • Reply webhook → intent classification → human review → meeting task.
  • Bounce or opt-out event → suppression list → campaign health review.
01

Use case 1

Launch segmented email sequences with reviewed personalization.

02

Use case 2

Route interested replies to the right sales owner through webhooks.

03

Use case 3

Track campaign replies, bounces, and unsubscribe events in a shared dashboard.

Inputs we need

  • Reviewed prospect segments and personalization fields
  • Configured sending domains, mailboxes, and campaign schedules
  • Approved messaging, unsubscribe rules, and reply ownership

Delivery sequence

  • Validate recipients, mailbox setup, and the campaign's stop conditions.
  • Configure sequences and webhooks, then test reply and unsubscribe handling.
  • Launch in agreed stages and review response quality with sales.

Expert review points

  • Approve outreach content and sender identity before campaign activation.
  • Review bounced, unsubscribed, and ambiguous-response records before follow-up.
